description: What the windows hosting the bundled frontend (main + child) may call. Exactly what apps/web and env_init_script invoke, and nothing else: any script in the document holds every permission listed here, so core:default and updater:default are not granted (the updater runs from Rust) and neither are autostart_status/autostart_set, which no web code calls yet. Local origin only: no window hosts a remote origin, and a remote document that ends up in one gets no IPC.
